title: Link request
description: What the authenticator fetches with `GET /consent/links/{id}` (header `X-Link-Secret`, device authentication of an active device) after it scanned the link code (protocol 1.2, spec section 14.3). The device renders `client` and `user_label`, never anything else about the party.

domain.description: Present exactly when domain_proven is true.

user_label.description: What the party calls this user, for example a masked name; untrusted text under the text rules of spec section 15, shown as reported by the service.

nonce.description: Signed back in the link statement.
